description: This file defines a Orleans grain class 'TransactionGrain' that implements transactional behavior with an associated state class 'Info'. It includes the necessary namespaces, a serializable state class, and the implementation of a grain that performs state updates transactionally.

classes.name: Info
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state with a single integer property 'Value'.

classes.name: TransactionGrain
classes.description: Grain class implementing ITransactionGrain, managing transactional state 'Info' and providing a 'Run' method to increment 'Value'.

methods.name: TransactionGrain
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transactional state dependency.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Performs a transactional update by incrementing 'Value' in the state.
